newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Ivorian coffee stocks seen at 60-70,000 tonnes.
newsitem.headline: Ivorian coffee stocks seen at 60-70,000 tonnes.

text.p: Robusta coffee stocks at Ivorian ports stood at about 60-70,000 tonnes in late June, port sources said on Monday.
Arrivals at port totalled just under 300,000 tonnes by late June, one shipping source said.
That figure needed to be reduced by 25-30 percent to allow for drying, grading or rejection of poor quality beans, he added.

The total adjusted tonnage for arrivals sorted would be around 225,000 tonnes, leaving stocks of between 60-70,000 tonnes after allowing for about 150,000 tonnes exported or set aside for roasting, he said.
Exports at the end of June were 122,000 tonnes, according to one set of figures, up from 98,000 tonnes by the end on May, he said.
Local roasters take around 30,000 tonnes of Ivorian beans a year.
